mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_TYPE, ROLE_CD, PASSWORD, MEMBER_NM, CELL_NO, EMAIL, CI_VAL, LOGIN_FAIL_CNT, LOCK_YN, LAST_LOGIN_DT, LAST_PW_MOD_DT, USE_YN, REG_DT FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
SELECT MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_TYPE, ROLE_CD, PASSWORD, MEMBER_NM, CELL_NO, EMAIL, CI_VAL, LOGIN_FAIL_CNT, LOCK_YN, LAST_LOGIN_DT, LAST_PW_MOD_DT, USE_YN, REG_DT FROM TB_MEMBER WHERE CI_VAL = #{ciVal}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_MEMBER SET LOGIN_FAIL_CNT = 0, LOCK_YN = 'N', LAST_LOGIN_DT = NOW() WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
UPDATE TB_MEMBER SET LOGIN_FAIL_CNT = LOGIN_FAIL_CNT + 1 WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
UPDATE TB_MEMBER SET LOGIN_FAIL_CNT = 5, LOCK_YN = 'Y' WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
UPDATE TB_MEMBER SET LOGIN_FAIL_CNT = 0, LOCK_YN = 'N' WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_MEMBER ( MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_TYPE, ROLE_CD, PASSWORD, MEMBER_NM, CELL_NO, EMAIL, CI_VAL, LOGIN_FAIL_CNT, LOCK_YN, LAST_LOGIN_DT, LAST_PW_MOD_DT, USE_YN, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{memberType}, #{roleCd}, #{password}, #{memberNm}, #{cellNo}, #{email}, #{ciVal}, 0, 'N', NOW(), NOW(), 'Y', NOW() )

INSERT INTO TB_LOGIN_LOG ( MEMBER_ID, MEMBER_TYPE, LOGIN_METHOD, LOGIN_SUCCESS_YN, FAIL_REASON, CLIENT_IP, USER_AGENT, LOGIN_DT ) VALUES ( #{memberId}, #{memberType}, #{loginMethod}, #{loginSuccessYn}, #{failReason}, #{clientIp}, #{userAgent}, NOW() )
